# atlassian_jira_workflow_scheme_attachment (Data Source)

Look up the workflow scheme attached to a Jira project.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project ID.

### Read-Only

- `workflow_scheme_id` (String) Attached workflow scheme ID.
- `workflow_scheme_name` (String) Attached workflow scheme name.
